## What problem would this solve?

Describe the workflow, limitation, or repeated manual task behind the request.
Concrete examples are especially helpful.

## Proposed behavior

Explain what you would like the plugin to do. If the request changes sync
behavior, describe the expected result in both Preview and Apply modes.

## Scope and safety

Which vManage objects and NetBox objects would be read, created, updated, or
removed? Note any configuration option or safeguard that should accompany the
feature.

## Alternatives considered

Mention current workarounds or other approaches you considered and why they do
not meet the need.

## Additional context

Add examples, screenshots, API references, or links to related issues. Remove
credentials and identifying infrastructure data before submitting.
